title: A dispute becomes a case file.
label: 01 / THE CASE
point: One place to review the claim.
speech: A chargeback leaves a small merchant with a claim to investigate and evidence to assemble. Rebuttal brings that review into a case file.

title: Read the evidence.
label: 02 / AVAILABLE RECORDS
note: Synthetic records shown in the original console recording.
speech: This is a recorded prototype using synthetic merchant records. The case groups order history, delivery records, and checkout terms so the reviewer can inspect the supporting material.

title: See what is missing.
label: 03 / EVIDENCE GAPS
note: Missing evidence is not proof that a claim is false.
speech: The same view identifies missing evidence. Here, the signature on file is absent. A missing record is a reason to investigate, not proof that the customer is wrong.

title: Keep the owner in the loop.
label: 04 / DECISION POINT
point: The recorded case is awaiting a reply.
note: Legacy SMS screen · no delivery or resume is demonstrated here.
speech: A high value case calls for human judgment. This recorded case is awaiting an owner reply. The visible screen is the earlier SMS interface; live delivery and session resume are not shown here.

title: Evidence first. Then a decision.
label: REBUTTAL / PROTOTYPE
point: Built with Strands Agents and Bedrock AgentCore.
note: Synthetic-data walkthrough · no real funds recovered in this demo.
speech: Rebuttal uses Strands Agents and Bedrock AgentCore to support evidence gathering and decision review. This walkthrough shows the case review experience, without claiming a real dispute win or measured savings.
